about: Utility menus (docs/round2-seams.md §6): window.IOUtilityMenus[id].html(ctx) -> the Utilities section's HTML. One entry per menu, pre-listed; the page loads utilities/<file> only for entries with ready=true and lists every one that registered html() in the bottom-right Prototype picker. A proposal lane rewrites ONLY its own file (u1-u5 start as copies of u0) and may rename ONLY its own line (entries are blank-line separated so parallel lanes merge cleanly).
